description: This file defines the RuntimeConf class for managing Spark runtime configurations via a client, including methods to set, get, unset, and check modifiability of configs, along with internal type checking and a test function.

classes.name: RuntimeConf
classes.description: Class for managing Spark runtime configuration settings through a client interface.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a configuration key to a specified value, converting boolean and integer types to strings.

methods.name: _set_all
methods.description: Sets multiple configurations at once, with an option to be silent.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a configuration key, with optional default.

methods.name: isModifiable
methods.description: Checks if a configuration key is modifiable.

methods.name: _checkType
methods.description: Internal method to verify that an argument is a string.
